A '''Bith''' was a criminal who lived during the [[Republic Era]] and was a member of the [[Duros]] criminal [[Lazlo]]'s [[Cad Bane's gang|gang]].<ref name="The Good Life" /> The [[Bith]] went with Lazlo to a mission and after Lazlo killed by a [[Unidentified marshal|marshal]], the Bith escaped with their spaceship, but died after the ship crashed on Lazlo's camp.<ref name="One Good Deed" />
